title: Public holidays of a country and its states, year by year, from the Nager.Date API
provider: Nager.Date (nager.at), the public holiday API v3, computed by its open-source library from each country's rules
licence: The Nager.Date library is MIT-licensed; the Web API's terms of service (2023-09-15) allow private and non-profit projects (commercial use needs a sponsorship) and forbid publishing the holidays as a holiday portal of one's own. The infrastructure is a non-profit project (ADR 0057).
citation: Nager.Date, Public holidays API v3, https://date.nager.at (library: https://github.com/nager/Nager.Date)
format: JSON, a file a year: a list of {date (YYYY-MM-DD), localName, name, countryCode, fixed, global (true for the whole country), counties (ISO 3166-2 codes of the states that keep it, or null), launchYear, types (Public, Bank, School, Optional, ...)}
coverage: Australia (AU), 2009 to 2026; the states as ISO 3166-2 subdivisions (Victoria AU-VIC). The rules are the library's, applied to past years as well, so that a holiday introduced later can appear in earlier years: the product checks Victoria's against the State's own dates where they are known.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country

australia.description: Australia's national and states' public holidays, 2009 to 2026
